note: Map layers for the console. pipeline/map_layers.py anchors each one on the console grid with GeoMapper (GeoTIFF: raster_to_matrix; CSV: CsvPointLayer + csv_to_matrices, one layer per numeric column). Paths are relative to this file. GeoTIFFs and CSVs dropped into this folder are picked up too.
